name: Korea, Republic of — Universities & Colleges (대학·전문대학)
title: Korea, Republic of — Universities & Colleges (대학·전문대학)
description: Directory of 491 accredited South Korean higher-education institutions (4-year universities 대학(4년제), junior colleges 전문대학, and graduate universities 대학원대학). Each record carries the institution's native Korean name (nameKr), education level, institution type, founding body (national/public/private), campus, administrative region (native + romanized), official web link, and three accreditation flags (degree-program / language-program / 'excellent' designation). Compiled by ystory/korea-universities from Korean government sources 커리어넷 (CareerNet, career.go.kr) and 한국유학종합시스템 (StudyInKorea, studyinkorea.go.kr).
